title: Thai Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired wrap filled with lamb and fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: Warm naan wrap
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a warm flour tortilla

instructions: 1. In a medium skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced lamb and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned.
3. Add the red Thai curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Stir in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 5 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
6. Warm the naan wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by spreading the lamb mixture onto the naan, followed by the chopped cilantro, lime juice, and sliced vegetables.
8. Serve immediately and garnish with chopped fresh mint if desired.
